mutations.because: This is the lane's whole point: without a default static-text layer, a fresh display-ad brief ships with no editable headline, exactly the gap AR7 was opened to close. Dropping it silently regresses to that gap — the type system does not catch it, since static-text was never structurally required to exist in a template's own literal shape, only in the creative type's `required` list, which a hand-authored canonical entry can still fail to satisfy.
